name: ai-to-pdf
title: AI to PDF
description: Convert Adobe Illustrator (.ai) files to print-ready PDF, with or without bleed, using Illustrator's own PDF export.
author: guus

commands.name: convert-ai-to-pdf
commands.title: Convert AI to PDF
commands.subtitle: Illustrator
commands.description: Pick one or more .ai files and export them to PDF, with the bleed read from the file, a custom bleed, or none.

commands.name: convert-selection-file-bleed
commands.title: Convert Finder Selection with Its Own Bleed
commands.subtitle: Illustrator
commands.description: Convert the .ai files selected in Finder, using the bleed each file itself defines.

commands.name: convert-selection-custom-bleed
commands.title: Convert Finder Selection with Custom Bleed
commands.subtitle: Illustrator
commands.description: Convert the .ai files selected in Finder using the custom bleed from the preferences.

commands.name: convert-selection-no-bleed
commands.title: Convert Finder Selection Without Bleed
commands.subtitle: Illustrator
commands.description: Convert the .ai files selected in Finder at trim size, without bleed.

preferences.name: defaultBleedMode
preferences.title: Default Bleed
preferences.description: Which bleed the commands start with.

preferences.name: customBleedMm
preferences.title: Custom Bleed
preferences.description: Millimetres on all four sides, used by the Custom option. A comma decimal works too.

preferences.name: pdfPreset
preferences.title: Default PDF Preset
preferences.description: Name of the Illustrator PDF preset used by default, including the brackets. Leave empty to use Illustrator's current settings.

preferences.name: suffixBleed
preferences.title: Suffix with Bleed
preferences.description: Appended to the file name when exporting with bleed.

preferences.name: suffixNoBleed
preferences.title: Suffix Without Bleed
preferences.description: Appended to the file name when exporting without bleed. May be empty.

preferences.name: destination
preferences.title: Output Folder
preferences.description: Where the PDFs are written. Leave empty to write next to the .ai file.

preferences.name: overwrite
preferences.title: Existing Files
preferences.label: Overwrite an existing PDF instead of numbering it
preferences.description: When off, a second export becomes "Name 2.pdf" instead of replacing the existing PDF.

preferences.name: revealInFinder
preferences.title: After Converting
preferences.label: Reveal the PDF in Finder
preferences.description: Selects the finished PDF in Finder once the conversion completes.

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout per File
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for Illustrator before giving up on a file.
